text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed near the shopping 
district—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's a crowd gathering over there, 
isn't there? I wonder what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wah, hot spring trip tickets~! How nice.
choice_data_list: Want to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll give it a spin! Um, excuse me, 
I'd like to draw once from the raffle, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Alright, that'll be one raffle ticket!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, right. The raffle tickets...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wawa, please wait a moment, I'm going to 
go do some shopping~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After hurriedly securing more raffle 
tickets, Matikanetannhauser gave the 
raffle wheel's crank another spin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehh!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I did it, I did it, I really went and 
did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoa, I'm so happy~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, so, when are we going!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A hot springs trip~ We're a bit busy right 
now, so maybe after things settle down a 
little?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, they're pair 
tickets. That said—
choice_data_list:
Are you sure you're okay pairing up with 
me?
Are you sure you want me as your partner?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Is it, by any chance, weird to invite 
my Trainer...?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um, I figured that when it comes to 
matching pairs like this, it's gotta be 
with my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
They're the one who takes care of me the 
most, my partner, or rather, umm...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...If you'd rather not, that's fine, 
though.
choice_data_list: Of course I don't hate it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ! Really!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yay, woohoo! Well then, let's come up with 
a new plan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I can't wait~. 'Trainer and the 
Steamy Hot Springs Mystery'—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah! No, no! Once I said the poetic intro, 
the rest just slipped out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, that's one more exciting plan 
added to the schedule!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! First prize!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
We missed out on the hot springs trip, but 
this looks so delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, since we have it, why don't we 
eat together? We could make it tonight's 
dinner!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course~. Oh, since we're at it, I'll 
whip up some side dishes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And with that said... Do you mind if we 
swing by the supermarket?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Matikane Tannhauser prepared a 
delicious dinner for us!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A "Special Deluxe Carrot Hamburg Steak," a 
side salad, corn soup, and—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's somen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The hamburger steak looks pretty big and 
heavy, so I thought something smooth like 
noodles would be nice for the main carb~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I chopped the green onions and shiso 
leaves too. I'll bring them over right 
away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, the food she prepared was 
delicious, and we had a wonderful time at 
dinner.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Second prize, huh~! So close~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I'm happy with this either way. 
Everything looks so glossy and delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, since we have so much, maybe I'll 
share some with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
At my family's diner, our neighbors used 
to share vegetables with us all the time, 
so I always kind of wanted to share things 
like that too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Ma'am, sorry for dropping by so late at 
night~. We harvested a whole bunch of 
carrots from our field~."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how wonderful! Thank you for going out 
of your way! Just a moment, we have some 
potatoes too—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, what are you making me do?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On that day, the student dorms seemed just 
a little livelier than usual.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aw man, third prize, huh! Too bad, too 
bad.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but lotteries are usually like 
this, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Since we have them, I want to make 
something delicious with these carrots."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...The kinpira at our cafeteria is so 
delicious. I wonder what the recipe was 
again...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'll try giving them a quick call!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, hello?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she made me the kinpira gobo 
that is supposedly served at her family's 
diner.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Too bad!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Even if a hot springs trip is out of 
reach, I was hoping we could at least get 
a single carrot, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nun... it's a tough world out there, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Matikanetannhauser ended up 
feeling just a little down in the dumps.
